_doc: Project defaults. Episodes override pack/theme/voice/pace in episodes/<slug>/episode.json; narration direction in 02-voice/direction.md; looks in engine/src/looks.json.
_contact: Your repository URL or contact page. Image hosts (Wikimedia) ask every client for a contact in its User-Agent; empty = a generic one (more rate-limiting).

licenses._doc: creditFreeOnly: only CC0 / public-domain / Pexels-Pixabay-Unsplash images (no credit line needed in captions). allowShareAlike applies when creditFreeOnly is false.

budget._doc: The studio never calls a paid API. Image generation is not an API here: an agent that has its own image tool (e.g. Codex $imagegen) may use it as a last resort (skills/05-image-sourcing).
